  "description": "SIMS Nigeria Limited - For over three decades, SIMS Nigeria Limited has grown from a single store to a nationwide business in the consumer electronics space with locations across Nigeria. Our journey of consistent growth and dedication has been driven by a commitment to quality in every aspect of our business. From our highly skilled and well-informed staff to the innovations and processes we bring to bear to ensure each customer receives top-tier service and dependable products.

With pride, we believe we are on a journey to building a legacy rooted in trust, innovation, and exceptional standards riding on our partnership with Samsung, Royal Electronics, Panasonic, Philips, Beko, Kenwood, Powermatic, and many others. Our values continue to guide us, allowing SIMS Nigeria Limited to thrive in a constantly evolving market while delivering lasting value to our customers, partners, and people across Nigeria. With premium products and unmatched service, we are honored to represent these trusted brands in Nigeria, bringing innovation and quality products directly to our customers with the sole aim of enriching their lives. As we continue to expand and adapt to meet the growing needs of our market, SIMS Nigeria Limited remains committed to setting the standard in product quality and service across the nation.&nbsp;

We are&nbsp;&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Service Centre Supervisor

Job Location: Aba Road, Rivers
Employment Type: Full-time

Role Overview


	The Service Centre Supervisor is responsible for supervising the technical operations of the service centre, ensuring the efficient diagnosis, repair, maintenance, and servicing of consumer electronics and home appliances.
	The role requires a strong hands-on technical background, with the ability to troubleshoot complex faults, guide technicians, manage repair workflows, and ensure that all jobs are completed accurately, safely, and within agreed turnaround times.


Key Responsibilities
Technical &amp; Repair Operations:


	Supervise and participate in the diagnosis, troubleshooting, repair, servicing, and maintenance of consumer electronics and home appliances such as air conditioners, refrigerators, washing machines, televisions, and other electrical/electronic products.
	Provide technical guidance to technicians on complex faults and repair procedures.
	Review and validate technical diagnoses before major repairs or replacement of components.
	Identify recurring technical faults and recommend appropriate corrective actions.
	Ensure proper use of diagnostic tools, testing equipment, service manuals, and technical resources.
	Conduct quality checks on completed repairs to ensure products are fully functional before release to customers.
	Ensure repairs are carried out in line with manufacturer specifications, technical standards, and safety requirements.


Team Supervision


	Supervise, assign, and monitor daily activities of service technicians.
	Provide on-the-job technical coaching and mentoring to improve technicians&#39; skills and productivity.
	Assess technicians&#39; technical capabilities and identify training needs.
	Monitor individual and team performance against service centre targets.
	Ensure proper adherence to standard operating procedures and safety practices.


Service Centre Operations


	Manage the end-to-end repair process from product receipt and diagnosis to repair, testing, and customer collection/delivery.
	Monitor turnaround time and ensure repairs are completed within agreed timelines.
	Review pending, delayed, and repeat-repair jobs and take corrective action.
	Ensure accurate documentation of repair activities, parts used, technical findings, and job status.
	Coordinate with the spare-parts/store team to ensure timely availability of required components.
	Escalate major technical issues, warranty concerns, and unrepairable products to management where necessary.


Customer &amp; Warranty Support


	Provide technical support in resolving customer complaints relating to product faults and repairs.
	Handle escalated technical complaints and ensure timely resolution.
	Verify warranty claims and ensure repairs are carried out in accordance with warranty policies.
	Explain technical findings and repair requirements to customers in a clear and professional manner.
	Minimize repeat complaints by ensuring proper diagnosis and quality repairs.


Reporting &amp; Control


	Prepare regular reports on repair volumes, turnaround time, technician productivity, repeat repairs, spare-parts usage, and unresolved technical issues.
	Monitor service centre KPIs and recommend improvements where performance falls below target.
	Maintain accurate records of repaired, pending, damaged, and unrepairable products.
	Track the usage and condition of technical tools and equipment.
	Ensure proper control and accountability for customer products received into the service centre.


Technical Competencies:
The ideal candidate should demonstrate:


	Strong practical knowledge of electrical and electronic systems.
	Hands-on experience diagnosing and repairing consumer electronics/home appliances.
	Ability to read and interpret circuit diagrams, wiring diagrams, and technical manuals.
	Knowledge of electrical testing and diagnostic equipment such as multimeters, clamp meters, insulation testers, and other relevant tools.
	Strong troubleshooting and fault-finding abilities.
	Understanding of PCB components, electrical circuits, sensors, motors, compressors, control boards, and other appliance components.
	Knowledge of preventive and corrective maintenance.
	Ability to identify root causes of technical failures rather than relying solely on component replacement.
	Good understanding of electrical safety and safe working practices.
	Ability to train and provide technical direction to technicians.


Key Requirements


	HND / B.Sc. in Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related technical field.
	Minimum of 4 years of relevant technical experience, preferably in a service centre, after-sales service, consumer electronics, or home appliances environment.
	Proven hands-on experience in troubleshooting and repairing appliances/electronic products.
	Previous experience supervising or leading technical personnel is an advantage.
	Strong knowledge of consumer electronics and home appliance repair.
	Ability to work under pressure and meet repair turnaround targets.
	Good problem-solving, communication, leadership, and organizational skills.


Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: employment@simsng.com using the&nbsp;Job Position and Location as the subject of the email.&nbsp;",

	Ability to develop strategic plans for market expansion and client acquisition
	Strong leadership in team collaboration and cross-functional projects
	Skilled in project management with a focus on customer relationship management.


Salary
N250,000 - N300,000 monthly (depending on Experience and Location).

Other Benefits:


	Official Car
	Annual Sales Commission and others.

	The ideal candidate must possess strong leadership, communication, negotiation, and entrepreneurial skills, with a proven ability to identify business opportunities, build and maintain strong customer relationships, and achieve sales targets.
	The successful candidate should be proactive, commercially minded, results-driven, and capable of adapting to changing market conditions.

	Uphold the highest standards of professionalism and conduct in a manner that protects and strengthens the company's brand and reputation.
	Manage depot logistics, inventory, and distribution activities to ensure smooth and efficient day-to-day operations.
	Coordinate regional sales activities to support the achievement of established sales targets.
	Develop and implement strategies to retain existing customers and strengthen customer loyalty.
	Identify and pursue opportunities to acquire new customers and expand the company's customer base.
	Develop and maintain strong, professional relationships with new and existing customers.
	Identify new business ventures, market opportunities, and potential areas for business expansion.
	Conduct market research to identify market gaps and recommend strategies to address them and create new business opportunities.
	Monitor and provide regular reports on depot performance, including sales performance, operational risks, challenges, and growth opportunities.
	Collaborate with relevant departments to resolve customer, logistics, inventory, and operational issues that may affect business performance.
	Perform any other duties or assignments as directed by management.
	Stay informed about industry trends, competitor activities, and market developments to identify new avenues for growth.


Experience and Educational Qualifications


	Bachelor’s Degree in either Business Administration, Marketing, Logistics, or a related field (an MBA would be an added advantage).
	At least 5 years of experience in management and business development.
	Strong entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to diversify revenue streams.
	Excellent leadership, communication, and negotiation skills.


Skills Required:


	Entrepreneurship
	Strong negotiation skills and ability to influence decision-makers at various level of the organisation
	Strong experience in business development management
	Excellent relationship management skills with the ability to build trust with clients and internal teams.
	Ability to develop strategic plans for market expansion and client acquisition
	Strong leadership in team collaboration and cross-functional projects
	Skilled in project management with a focus on customer relationship management.


Salary
N250,000 - N300,000 monthly (depending on Experience and Location).

Other Benefits:


	Official Car
	Annual Sales Commission and others.

title: Job Openings at Sycamore Integrated Solutions Limited
content:
Sycamore-ng is Financial and Technology (Fintech) services company, that operates a financial marketplace for lenders and borrowers. With a team of skilled professionals and cutting edge technology, we are well suited to cater for both businesses and individuals who need loans (borrowers), or want to make returns (lenders) on our marketplace.

We are recruiting to fill the following positions below: 

1.) Creche Attendant

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time 

Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Supervise and care for infants and young children throughout the day.
	Feed, change, and maintain children's hygiene as required.
	Organize age-appropriate play and learning activities.
	Ensure the creche remains clean, safe, and well-organized.
	Monitor children's health and promptly report any concerns.
	Maintain daily attendance and care records.
	Communicate effectively with parents regarding their children's well-being.
	Follow all health, safety, and child safeguarding procedures.
	Support emergency response procedures when necessary.


Requirements


	Minimum of SSCE, OND, or a relevant childcare qualification.
	Minimum of 5 years of experience working in a creche, nursery, daycare, or childcare setting.
	Basic knowledge of child development and childcare practices.
	First Aid certification is an added advantage.
	Good communication and interpersonal skills.
	Patient, compassionate, and trustworthy.
	Ability to maintain confidentiality and professionalism.


Application Closing Date: 4th September, 2026.

Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.

 

 

2.) Credit Risk Specialist

Job Location: Ikeja, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time 

Job Responsibility
Credit Underwriting:


	Review and analyse loan applications to determine borrowers' creditworthiness and repayment capacity.


Due Diligence & Verification:


	Conduct thorough KYC and customer verification before recommending credit facilities.
	Review credit bureau reports and investigate adverse findings or inconsistencies.
	Verify employment, business operations, income sources, bank statements, addresses, and other relevant information.
	Identify discrepancies, suspicious documentation, misrepresentation, and potential fraud indicators.
	Escalate significant red flags to the appropriate Risk, Compliance, or Management team.


Credit Policy & Risk Management:


	Ensure all underwriting decisions comply with SycamoreNG's credit policy and approval framework.
	Identify policy exceptions and ensure they receive the appropriate approval.
	Assess concentration, indebtedness, repayment capacity, and other relevant credit risks.
	Ensure conditions precedent are satisfied before recommending disbursement.
	Contribute to the review and improvement of underwriting policies, processes, and credit assessment models.


Portfolio Monitoring;


	Monitor the performance of assigned loan portfolios and identify early warning signs of deterioration.
	Review existing facilities for renewals, restructures, modifications, and additional exposures.
	Provide insights on emerging credit risks and recurring causes of delinquency.
	Work with the Risk and Recovery teams to improve portfolio quality.


Documentation & Reporting:


	Ensure credit files are complete, accurate, and properly documented.
	Review loan documentation and facility terms before disbursement.
	Prepare regular reports on underwriting volumes, approval rates, declines, exceptions, turnaround time, and portfolio performance.
	Support internal audits, compliance reviews, and regulatory examinations.


Stakeholder Management:


	Work closely with Sales, Relationship Managers, Credit Operations, Recovery, Compliance, Legal, and Finance teams.
	Challenge incomplete or weak credit proposals professionally and objectively.
	Communicate credit decisions and recommendations clearly to relevant stakeholders.
	Maintain independence and sound judgment when making lending decisions.
	Assess applicants' income, cash flow, financial statements, bank statements, credit history, existing obligations, and overall financial position.
	Review consumer, SME, and other assigned loan applications based on applicable credit policies.
	Prepare clear and well-supported credit appraisal reports and recommendations.
	Approve, decline, or escalate applications within assigned approval limits.
	Identify risks and recommend appropriate mitigants, loan structures, conditions, and security requirements.


Requirements


	Bachelor's Degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Banking, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
	3–5 years of relevant experience in credit underwriting, credit analysis, risk management, banking, microfinance, or fintech lending.
	Experience in commercial banking, digital lending, or fintech environments is strongly preferred.
	Proven experience underwriting consumer and/or SME loans.
	Strong understanding of credit assessment and lending principles.
	Good knowledge of KYC, credit bureau checks, fraud detection, and credit documentation.
	Ability to analyse financial statements and bank statements.
	Strong understanding of lending policies and risk management principles.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and relevant credit/lending systems.
	Strong analytical and numerical skills.
	Excellent attention to detail.
	Strong written and verbal communication skills.
	High level of integrity and sound independent judgment.


Application Closing Date: 31st August, 2026. 

Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail. 

 

3.) IT Support

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Key Responsibilities


	Serve as First Line of Response for IT Support
	Carry out Audits of System activities to ensure compliance to organisational Policies
	Diagnose, repair, and maintain laptops, desktops, and other IT equipment.
	Install, configure, and troubleshoot network systems (LAN, WAN, routers, switches Firewalls).
	Maintain and monitor access logs to ensure secure use of systems and devices.
	Carry out installation, updates, and management of organizational IT devices.
	Provide user support for hardware, software, and connectivity issues.
	Ensure timely backup and recovery of important data and systems.
	Maintain an inventory of IT equipment, licenses, and warranties.
	Implement security best practices in device Management.
	Prepare technical reports and documentation of IT activities and incidents.


Qualifications & Skills


	Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field (or equivalent experience).
	Proven experience in laptop/desktop repair and maintenance.
	Strong knowledge of networking principles and troubleshooting.
	Experience with operating systems (Windows, macOS).
	Familiarity with IT asset and device management.
	Excellent troubleshooting and analytical skills.
	Strong communication and customer service skills.
	Ability to work independently and as part of a team.


Preferred Certifications (not mandatory):


	CompTIA Network+
	Cisco CCNA


Application Closing Date: 22nd September, 2026.

Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.
